answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, idle agents bleed standing. The grove of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The spiral holds work receipts rather than names, so the nebula of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
